summary: Generation Income Properties (GIPR) filed an 8-K reporting amendments to its operating partnership's limited partnership agreement. The Eighth and Ninth Amendments eliminate redemption rights for Series B-1 and B-2 preferred units held by two holders (LMB Owenton I LLC and Lloyd M. Bernstein), converting them into exchangeable units for common stock at a 1:1 ratio (subject to adjustment for a 1-for-10 reverse split effective July 9, 2026). The B-1 holder can exchange from July 24, 2026; B-2 from February 6, 2027. GIPR or the operating partnership may settle in cash or stock at its discretion. This restructuring reduces cash redemption obligations, potentially diluting common equity. Watch for shareholder dilution impact and any further partnership amendments.
